oneLine: Quality Enviro Engineers plans an SME IPO.

sources.title: Quality Enviro Engineers: Business, Valuation & SME IPO Plan

synopsis: Quality Enviro Engineers Limited, a Ghaziabad-based manufacturer of municipal cleaning machines such as sewer suction machines, road sweepers, and anti-smog guns, is preparing to file for an SME IPO. The company posted ₹63 crore in revenue and ₹5 crore in profit for FY26. The business is family-controlled, with Chairman and Managing Director Ashwani Srivastava and promoter Neha Srivastava together owning approximately 72% of the company. Recent corporate preparations include appointing a Company Secretary, a CFO, three independent directors, raising authorized capital from ₹5 crore to ₹18 crore, and dropping "Private" from its name. The article details past private placements, including a May 2024 raise of ₹13 crore and a September 2026 10:1 bonus issue, but does not disclose any current deal value or stake-sale proceeds.
